subject.title: refactor(qa): finish Matrix QA Lab ownership

question: After the redirect repair and dependent stack are ready, should the intentional removal of `@openclaw/qa-matrix` and its lockfile importer be authorized for the exact final head?
rationale: The package is described as temporary and the ownership consolidation is well-proven, but repository policy requires explicit authorization for this dependency-graph change and coordinated stack landing.

options.title: Authorize after repairs
options.body: Restore both redirects, verify the dependent stack, review the package-removal delta, and authorize the exact final head.

options.title: Retain the shim temporarily
options.body: Keep the compatibility package and importer until source-checkout consumers or stack ordering can be proven safe.

recommendation.title: Authorize after repairs
recommendation.body: Restore both redirects, verify the dependent stack, review the package-removal delta, and authorize the exact final head.
